title: Single-cell RNA sequencing of meningiomas

publications.title: XCVATR: detection and characterization of variant impact on the Embeddings of single -cell and bulk RNA-sequencing samples.

anatomic_location_breakdown: convexity (parietal and frontal regions, one sample each); source overall_design literally reads 'postal and frontal regions', apparently a typo for 'parietal'
needs_manual_review_reason: Series-level GEO metadata verified directly against the live source (2026-07-10): overall_design explicitly states 'single-cell RNA sequencing from one meningioma patient. This one patient had two meningioma tissues from postal and frontal regions,' confirming patient_count=1 and anatomic location, now reflected in the record. Remaining per-sample clinical/pathology fields (grade, sex/age, brain invasion, treatment timepoint) have not yet been extracted from individual GSM records or supplementary tables. Publication metadata pulled from PubMed esummary and spot-checked against esummary author/venue/DOI data.

gene_expression_viewer.embedding_method: scanpy 1.10.3: read_10x_mtx of GSM6588919 (Postal) and GSM6588920 (Frontal)'s deposited raw (unfiltered, ~6.79M-barcode) Cell Ranger output, QC (min 200 genes/cell, <20% pct_counts_mt; 28157 and 14779 real cells kept respectively), anndata.concat (unintegrated), filter_genes min_cells=3 (23369 genes), normalize_total+log1p, top-2000 HVG, PCA, neighbors, UMAP, Leiden (resolution 0.5, 9 clusters, igraph flavor). Gene panel: 11 guaranteed meningioma driver genes + top HVGs by dispersion to 200 total.
gene_expression_viewer.integration_note: Both samples were merged by raw concatenation, not batch-corrected/integrated (same approach ScPCA documents for its own merged per-project objects) -- use "color by sample" to check whether cells separate by patient/site rather than assuming a shared embedding means removed batch effects.
